title: Nixer N6 Mixer Kit Freebase HVG - 6mg
description: The Nixer Freebase HVG Mixer Kit N6 allows you to create 60ml of 6mg freebase e-liquid with a high VG ratio of 70VG/30PG. This kit is perfect for sub-ohm vapers who enjoy producing large, dense clouds of vapour with high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) vape kits. Each kit contains everything you need to mix with your Nixer Longfill Flavour concentrates, including nic shots and VG boosters. Simply combine the contents of the Mixer Kit with your chosen Nixer Longfill concentrate to create a customised e-liquid tailored to your vaping preferences. Nixer Mixer Kits are designed to provide a versatile and convenient solution for vapers who want to customise their e-liquids. Made in the UK by Dispergo, these kits ensure a premium vaping experience with your preferred nicotine strength and VG/PG ratio. How to use the Nixer Mixer Kit: 1 . Open your Nixer Longfill e-liquid concentrate bottle and pull out the nib. 2 . Pour in all 3 bottles contained in your chosen Nixer Mixer Kit. 3 . Reattach the nib back on the longfill bottle and put the lid on. 4 . Shake the bottle vigorously for 1 minute. 5 . Your e-liquid is ready.
